chunks: Muʿāwiyah ibn Wahb asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the blood money for intentional killing, and he said:
"One hundred mature male camels. If they are not available, then in place of each camel there are twenty mature male sheep."

key_terms.دِيَةِ الْعَمْدِ: the blood money for intentional killing
key_terms.فُحُولَةِ الْإِبِلِ: male camels used here as the standard compensation
key_terms.فُحُولَةِ الْغَنَمِ: male sheep given as a substitute compensation

ai.seo_question: What is the diyyah for intentional killing according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the diyyah for intentional killing. Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام states that it is one hundred mature male camels, and if such camels are unavailable, each camel is replaced by twenty mature male sheep.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5197 - Muawiyah ibn Wahb asked Abu Abdullah (as) about the blood money (diyyah) for intentional killing.
Imam (as) said: "It is one hundred mature male camels. If they are not available, then for each camel, twenty mature male sheep are to be given in its place."
